title: Principal Systems Engineer - BESS Product Development
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a Principal Systems Engineer, you will drive system architecture, technical meetings, and engineering excellence across Fluence’s product portfolio. You will lead the definition of complex multi\-megawatt (multi\-MW) system architectures, guide multidisciplinary engineering teams, and directly influence product roadmaps.
   

  

 This role requires deep technical expertise, exceptional systems thinking, and the ability to solve the energy storage industry's most challenging engineering problems while mentoring engineers and establishing world\-class systems engineering best practices across the organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as the systems architecture lead for utility\-scale energy storage products (BESS) and platform development.
* Develop, maintain, and oversee product system architecture, integrating batteries, power conversion systems (PCS), transformers, communications, auxiliary power, mechanical, software, and controls.
* Lead system\-level requirements, functional decomposition, interface control documents (ICDs), and technical specifications using tools like JAMA Connect or MBSE tools
* Drive technical trade\-offs and resolve complex, cross\-disciplinary challenges
* Lead preparation for technical reviews and provide technical guidance for major Product Development initiatives
* Partner with Product Management, engineering leadership, and business stakeholders to define long\-term technology roadmaps.
* Convert customer, market, regulatory, and grid\-connection requirements into highly scalable technical architectures.
* Champion platform standardization, modularity, and product scalability across multiple generations of products
* Lead system\-level trade studies balancing performance, safety, reliability, manufacturability, cost, and schedule.
* Own complex integration strategies across electrical, mechanical, controls, communications, and cloud interfaces.
* Define verification and validation (V\&V) strategies. Collaborate with lab and field engineering teams to oversee hardware testing, prototype validation, FAT/SAT protocols, and full qualification
* Support, lead, and facilitate Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Management of Change, and incorporate field feedback into future designs
* Lead product safety engineering activities, including DFMEA, FMEA, HARA, and Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)
* Ensure product compliance with global standards, codes, and regulatory requirements (e.g., UL 9540, UL 9540A, IEC 62933, NFPA 855, NFPA 70, IEEE, etc).
* Actively mentor, coach, and guide Systems Engineers across multiple product lines.
* Drive collaboration across Product Management, Hardware, Software, Controls, Manufacturing, Quality, and Service teams


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 12\+ years of industry experience in systems engineering, product development, or system architecture within renewable energy or power systems.
* Extensive experience with utility\-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Power Conversion Systems (PCS), microgrids, or grid integration
* Deep understanding of systems engineering principles, including requirements development, functional decomposition, interface management, system architecture, and verification \& validation.
* Strong technical background spanning electrical, mechanical, controls, embedded, and software systems.
* Proven track record of conducting safety and risk assessments (DFMEA, FMEA, HARA) and root cause analysis.
* Experience developing products compliant with international safety and performance standards (UL 9540, UL 9540A, IEC 62933, NFPA 855, etc.)


**Our Culture**
 At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world.
   

  

**Unleash Voices**
 We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress.
   

  

**Customer Fluent**
 Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate.
   

  

**Infinite Impact**
 We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game\-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy\-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come.
   

  

**All In**
 We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success.

title: ARM Server SoC Software & Firmware Systems Engineer (Sr. Staff / Principal)
description:

 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**

**General Summary**
 Our Mission
   

  

 Qualcomm is transforming the compute industry by delivering cloud\-scale, production\-ready ARM server platforms. We design server\-class SoCs that integrate high\-performance CPUs with advanced interconnects and a robust software stack—optimized for performance, reliability, security, and operational efficiency at hyperscale.
   

  

 Our charter is to deliver reference ARM server platforms based on Qualcomm server SoCs, spanning silicon enablement, firmware, OS and hypervisor integration, documentation, and ecosystem support for datacenter customers.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Qualcomm is seeking a Sr. Staff / Principal level ARM Server SoC Software \& Firmware Systems Engineer to act as a system\-level technical leader for our next\-generation ARM server platforms.
   

  

 This role is a cross\-disciplinary technical leadership position with responsibility for guiding end\-to\-end system architecture across silicon, firmware, OS, and platform software. You will align multiple engineering teams around architectural intent, guide critical design decisions, track execution across organizational boundaries, and ensure delivery meets production and hyperscale requirements.

* Influence long\-term platform and SoC roadmaps through system\-level analysis and technical leadership.
* Produce high\-quality architecture documentation, technical guidance, and executive\-level summaries.
* Mentor senior engineers and emerging architects across firmware and system software domains.
* Minimum Qualifications

* 12\+ years of experience in system software, firmware, or SoC architecture for server or datacenter platforms.
* Strong understanding of ARM64 server architectures and system software stacks.
* Broad technical depth across firmware, OS, hypervisors, power/performance management, RAS, memory, PCIe, and platform services.
* Demonstrated experience leading large, cross\-functional technical initiatives without direct reporting authority.
* Proven ability to reason at system level and balance architectural rigor with execution realities.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage engineering teams, senior leadership, and customers
* Preferred Qualifications
* Master’s degree or equivalent industry experience.
* 15\+ years of experience delivering production server SoCs or hyperscale platforms.
* Experience working directly with hyperscaler customers or large datacenter operators.
* Familiarity with ARM, OCP, or related industry standards bodies.
* Demonstrated success operating at Sr. Staff or Principal Engineer level, influencing architecture and execution across organizations


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6\+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

* Strong communicator who can bridge the gap between complex technical solutions and non\-technical business stakeholders.

title: Technical Projects Systems Engineer
description:
**Position Description – Customer Proof Of Concepts Engineer**
**Global Demonstration Engineering is the** 
 world class leader in delivering innovative, demonstration\-centric experiences of Cisco solutions to customer providing a full\-suite, integrated sales\-enablement portfolio. By demonstrating to customers how Cisco products can make them more productive, sales teams and partners can enlarge sales opportunities and shorten the sales cycle. From scripted, repeatable demos to fully customizable labs with complete administrative access, the Cisco dCloud platform provides content and access to field and channel partners on any network (internal \& external), any device and in any location. The dCloud Platform is a force that can not only improve people’s experiences but can also drive business.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The CPOC Engineer is an SE role who will be responsible for the development, planning, design, delivery \& coordination of Customer Proof of Concept Labs, spanning the full breadth of Cisco architectures and solutions – Enterprise Networking, Data Center, SD\-WAN, Security, Collaboration, and Cloud – for both internal and external audiences. This person will work extensively with BU’s, Content Developers, Partners, both internal \& 3rd party throughout the POC process from introduction through build, test and ultimately throughout the customer delivery of the POC. This person will be responsible for working with account teams to flesh out customer care abouts, testing requirements, capabilities, etc. This is an AI\-native engineering role: the CPOC Engineer is expected to use AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor to generate and refine scripts, and apply them through Ansible and Terraform to configure any Cisco and cloud solution rapidly, consistently, and at scale.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
**Project Management 10%**
 Identify and prioritize all project related tasks. Ability to organize, strategize and communicate project goals, objectives and tasks at all levels of the organization. The CPOC Engineer will be responsible for ensuring that all 3rd party developers on assigned projects are reporting status effectively.
   

  

**Engineering 50%**
 The CPOC Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, documenting, and delivering a large variety of content, across all Cisco architectures – Enterprise Networking, Data Center, SD\-WAN, Security, and Cloud. This will require meeting with Account Teams, TME’s, Content Developers, Partners and at times Customers to extract requirements and helping to create a design \& Test Plan which is conducive to POC objectives. The CPOC Engineer will be the primary engineer assigned to the POC from introduction throughout Build, Test and ultimately delivery phases of the Customer Proof of Concept. The Engineer will work and Collaboration with a team of engineers with varying specialties.
   

  

**Platform Design 20%**
 Must properly document and plan all projects prior to entering project build phase. Candidate must be well versed in the use of standard design templates and tools (Visio, Power Point, MS Project). Candidate will be required to “justify” all designs in front of working peer group.
   

  

**Support 10%**
 The CPOC Engineer will serve as First Point of Contact on All Escalations. Within this role and work directly with the account teams, partners and customers to ensure the successful delivery of the POC. When escalations occur that cannot be addressed by the CPOC Engineer, he/she will follow up with the responsible engineer and ensure that not only is a fix provided but also that it is properly documented and has been added to the Support Knowledge Base and that tier 1 \& 2 engineers have been properly trained on the work around and future. If a content or documentation update is required, the CPOC Engineer will work with Proect managers assigned to the CPOC team to ensure that plans have been for the necessary updates. The CPOC Engineers will be involved in all Phases of the POC. Engineers will work as the liaison to the operations team to resolve issues identified during the development and testing process, providing technical support, and making design recommendations for fixes.
   

  

**Other 5%**
 The CPOC Engineer will work as both 3rd party liaison’s and as an independent content developer.
   

  

**Candidate Requirements**
* CCNP/CCIE level or equivalent experience
* Multi\-architecture Cisco experience: able to work across any Cisco architecture or solution with customers – Enterprise Networking, Data Center, SD\-WAN, Security, Collaboration, and Cloud.
* AI\-assisted engineering: hands\-on proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor to generate, review, and refine scripts, and apply them through Ansible or Terraform to configure any Cisco and cloud solution end\-to\-end.
* Strong Routing, Switching, and Security background.
* OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, MPLS, DMVPN, IPSec, NAT, Trustsec, LISP, VXLAN, EVPN, 802\.1x etc.
* Cisco Catalyst SD\-WAN Experience
* Controller Deployment and Design (On\-Premise, Cloud)
* Template Management (Device Templates, Configuration Groups)
* Policy Management (Centralized Policy, Localized Policy, Data Policy)
* Cloud On\-Ramp for Multi\-Cloud
* Cisco Software Defined Access Experience
* Cisco Catalyst Center (DNA Center) Deployment and management
* Network device management (Provisioning, SWIM, Templates, Plug\-and\-Play)
* Cisco SD\-Access Fabric
* Cloud Networking Experience (AWS, Azure, GCP), Microsoft Office365
* Considerate experience with Virtual Infrastructures (VMware VCenter and VMs)
* Experience with Test Tools such as; Spirent, Cyberflood, Avalanche, Ixia, Keysight, WAN Emulation.
* Experience with Cisco Security products is a plus:
* SSE, Meraki, Secure Access, Secure Cloud Control, NGFW, ISE, Stealthwatch, ThousandEyes and Umbrella
* Others, e.g. Threat Defense, Defense Orchestrator, Cyber Vision, Thousand Eyes, Office 365
* Proven record of project delivery, Project Management and Time Management abilities

* Basic Programing and Scripting: Go, Python, Ruby, Powershell, XML, SQL, etc.

* Automation \& Infrastructure\-as\-Code: Python, Ansible, Terraform, REST APIs, and CI/CD pipelines to build repeatable, scalable POC and lab environments that benefit the whole team.
